scenario: A `Json` path read compiles: whether the path resolves is a runtime question, and a path that doesn't resolve reads as absent (LERR.1.3.3), so the compiler cannot refuse it. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES; a leaf of the wrong type is a TypeError at runtime (LERR.1.3.4), not tested here.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    data: Json mutable

rule r:
    Payload p where p.data.count > 0
->
    log info "has count"
